verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בִּ֝הְיוֹת֗וֹ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה׃ אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ אֵלִ֥י אֲ‍ֽשַׁחֲ֫רֶ֥ךָּ אַתָּ֗ה לְךָ֨׀ נַפְשִׁ֗י צָמְאָ֬ה לְךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י כָּמַ֣הּ צִיָּ֖ה וְעָיֵ֣ף בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ בְּלִי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ bih·yō·w·ṯōw bə·miḏ·bar yə·hū·ḏāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ê·lî ’ăša·ḥă·re·kā ’at·tāh lə·ḵā nap̄·šî ṣā·mə·’āh lə·ḵā ḇə·śā·rî kā·mah ṣî·yāh wə·‘ā·yêp̄ bə·’e·reṣ- bə·lî- mā·yim
verses.literal: A Psalm of David when he was in the Wilderness of Judah O God You are my God Earnestly I seek You my soul thirsts for You My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water

verses.original: כֵּ֭ן חֲזִיתִ֑יךָ בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ לִרְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: So I have seen You in the sanctuary [and] beheld Your power and glory

verses.original: כִּי־ חַ֭סְדְּךָ ט֣וֹב מֵֽחַיִּ֗ים שְׂפָתַ֥י יְשַׁבְּחֽוּנְךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥas·də·ḵā ṭō·wḇ mê·ḥay·yîm śə·p̄ā·ṯay yə·šab·bə·ḥū·nə·ḵā
verses.literal: Because Your loving devotion is better than life my lips will glorify You

verses.original: כֵּ֣ן אֲבָרֶכְךָ֣ בְחַיָּ֑י בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂ֥א כַפָּֽי׃
verses.literal: So I will bless You as long as I live in Your name I will lift my hands

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֑י תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע כְּמ֤וֹ חֵ֣לֶב וָ֭דֶשֶׁן רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י פִּֽי׃ יְהַלֶּל־
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî tiś·ba‘ kə·mōw ḥê·leḇ wā·ḏe·šen rə·nā·nō·wṯ wə·śip̄·ṯê pî yə·hal·lel-
verses.literal: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods with joyful lips my mouth will praise You

verses.original: אִם־ זְכַרְתִּ֥יךָ עַל־ יְצוּעָ֑י אֶהְגֶּה־ בָּֽךְ׃ בְּ֝אַשְׁמֻר֗וֹת
verses.literal: When I remember You on my bed I think of You through the watches of the night

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י אֲרַנֵּֽן׃ וּבְצֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ
verses.literal: For You are my help I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֣י דָּבְקָ֣ה אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝֗י יְמִינֶֽךָ׃ תָּמְכָ֥ה
verses.literal: My soul clings to You Your right hand upholds me

verses.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לְ֭שׁוֹאָה יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm·māh yə·ḇaq·šū nap̄·šî lə·šō·w·’āh yā·ḇō·’ū bə·ṯaḥ·tî·yō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth

verses.original: יַגִּירֻ֥הוּ עַל־ יְדֵי־ חָ֑רֶב יִהְיֽוּ׃ מְנָ֖ת שֻׁעָלִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: yag·gî·ru·hū ‘al- yə·ḏê- ḥā·reḇ yih·yū mə·nāṯ šu·‘ā·lîm
verses.literal: They will fall to the power of the sword they will become a portion for foxes

verses.original: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ֮ יִשְׂמַ֪ח בֵּאלֹ֫הִ֥ים כָּל־ הַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בּ֑וֹ יִ֭תְהַלֵּל כִּ֥י פִּ֣י דֽוֹבְרֵי־ שָֽׁקֶר׃ יִ֝סָּכֵ֗ר
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ yiś·maḥ bê·lō·hîm kāl- han·niš·bā‘ bōw yiṯ·hal·lêl kî pî ḏō·wḇ·rê- šā·qer yis·sā·ḵêr
verses.literal: But the king will rejoice in God all who swear by Him will exult for the mouths of liars . . . will be shut
